name: portfolio-monograph
description: Master spatial portfolio design, curation, and architectural critique system created by Sara Bensalem. Provides Swiss typography rules, 10 layout archetypes, the 5-act spatial case study narrative, and a 100-point audit rubric to eliminate render traps and build high-converting architecture, interior architecture, and urban design portfolios.
author: Sara Bensalem <sara@sarabensalem.com>

tools.name: compile_monograph_spread
tools.description: Compiles 16:9, 2:1, 1:1, 4:3, and A4 landscape Swiss editorial spreads across 20 empirical looks with modular grids (6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 16 cols) and Project Passports.

tools.name: audit_portfolio
tools.description: Quantitative 100-point structural portfolio audit engine evaluating page budgets, aspect ratios, word counts, and anti-render-trap redline alerts.

tools.name: orchestrate_case_study
tools.description: Synthesizes multi-scale architectural plates into an integrated HTML5 technical dossier and publication case study.

tools.name: portfolio_forensic_linter
tools.description: Forensic PDF linter detecting Antipatterns #18 (flattened rasters), #19 (metadata copy-paste), #20 (consumer metadata stamps), and inverted technical sheets.
